## Summary
Orders device buffers across CUDA streams around MPI operations, as a step toward addressing the zero-receive failures in multi-GPU vector DSS tests in ClimaCore on L40S ([ddss_ne32_cs.jl](https://buildkite.com/clima/climacore-ci/builds/7732#01a0892c-2f26-4444-ab08-d30ddc1da4d7)). (This PR in itself may not fix the failure.)

`CUDA.jl` launches kernels on per-task non-blocking streams (`CU_STREAM_NON_BLOCKING`), which do not automatically synchronize with the legacy default stream or with UCX's internal CUDA streams, and `CUDA.synchronize()` only synchronizes the calling Julia task's stream.

- Adds `ClimaComms.device_synchronize(::AbstractDevice)` (`CUDA.device_synchronize()` on `CUDADevice`, a no-op on CPU devices).
- Calls it before posting MPI operations in `ClimaComms.start`, after `MPI.Waitall` in `ClimaComms.finish`, and around MPI collectives on array buffers (`reduce`, `reduce!`, `allreduce`, `allreduce!`, `gather`). Collectives on scalars and other host values skip the synchronization.
- `reduce!` and `allreduce!` on `MPICommsContext` now return `nothing`, as documented and as on `SingletonCommsContext`.
title: Synchronize CUDA device across MPI streams
